wisdom.text: Know your imam. Whoever knows his imam is as if he is with al-Qa’im in his pavilion.
wisdom.label: Al-Ghayba, ch. 25

wisdom.text: He will fill the earth with justice just as it was filled with tyranny.
wisdom.label: Signs of the Appearance, ch. 14

wisdom.text: Mahdi is from my family and will fight for my tradition, just as I fought for the Qur’an.
